heading: \reals
source:
[\reals]
Defines: Rb ::= (R, 0, 1, +, *, neg(x_), inv(x_), leq(a_, b_))
abstractly:
specifies:
. R is \set
. 0 "in" R
. 1 "in" R
. + is \binary.operation:on{R}
. * is \binary.operation:on{R}
. neg is \function:on{R}:to{R}
. inv is \function:on{R}:to{R}
. leq is \total.order:on{R}
expresses:
. 0 != 1
. inv(0) = 0
. forAll: a, b, c "in" R
  then:
  . (a + b) + c = a + (b + c)
  . a + b = b + a
  . a + 0 = a
  . a + neg(a) = 0
  . (a * b) * c = a * (b * c)
  . a * b = b * a
  . a * 1 = a
  . a * (b + c) = (a * b) + (a * c)
  . if: a != 0
    then: a * inv(a) = 1
  . if: leq(a, b)
    then: leq(a + c, b + c)
. forAll: a, b "in" R
  where:
  . leq(0, a)
  . leq(0, b)
  then: leq(0, a * b)
. forAll: A \:subset:/ R
  where:
  . exists: x "in" R
    suchThat: x "in" A
  . exists: M "in" R
    suchThat:
    . forAll: x "in" R
      where: x "in" A
      then: leq(x, M)
  then:
  . exists: s "in" R
    suchThat:
    . forAll: x "in" R
      where: x "in" A
      then: leq(x, s)
    . forAll: u "in" R
      where:
      . forAll: x "in" R
        where: x "in" A
        then: leq(x, u)
      then: leq(s, u)
Enables:
. capability: x_ "in" Rb :-> x_ is \real
. view:
  as: S := R is \set
Documented:
. called: "the reals"
. written: "\mathbb{R}"
. description: "The real numbers $(\mathbb{R}, 0, 1, +, \cdot, \le)$ as a
                complete ordered field."
